text:
I visited Ms. Tantapakul’s clinic after I strained something in my arm and/or neck, and the mild but persistent pain had been driving me crazy for three days straight. She asked very detailed questions about my symptoms, then gave me a physical therapy session followed by an EMS treatment (electrodes are placed on the muscles and a gentle current is used to help them relax).

After about an hour, the pain was gone. It returned slightly later in the afternoon, but after a good night’s sleep it was mostly gone the next day — and it completely disappeared the day after that.

Ms. Tantapakul also showed me her impressive collection of diplomas from therapeutic courses with trainers from all around the world, which gave me even more confidence in her expertise.

Highly recommended.

This therapist used pressure, heat, ultrasound and I think one other thing and yes my headaches went away!  As a huge proponent of chiropractic I was thrilled and  frankly surprised that physio could do this for me.

I have had my share of physio treatments but she is different so I went back the next day to see what she could do for my chronic recurring hip tightness and pain. She used laser, TENS, ultrasound, heat, another type of laser and a magnetic device. Wow. That night falling asleep I still help a minor amount of pain but today my hips feel amazing. She also gave me basic good physio advice on how to take care of myself going forward— be gentle, be consistent, stretch and strengthen daily….all the things I know but need to be reminded of. You want to go here!
